snippet.title: Snug - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Snug is a cozy game about packing bags just the way you like. Stack, sort, and squeeze everyday objects into oddly shaped spaces with physics, jiggling, and the satisfaction of fitting things neatly into place. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4017680/Snug/
